# <Language> Engineering Standard

## Purpose

Define the durable engineering quality contract for the registered language.

## Authority

State what this standard controls and which higher-order scope/architecture/module/contract authorities it cannot override.

## Core rules

Define high-value normative language rules.

## Source and API

Define source-structure, naming, type, API, and compatibility rules that are genuinely language-specific.

## Boundaries

Define language-level dependency/boundary practices while referencing project architecture rather than duplicating it.

## Errors and resources

Define language-specific error, lifecycle, resource, concurrency, and cleanup rules as applicable.

## Testing

Define language-specific testing expectations without restating project workflow.

## Security

Define language-specific secure-coding rules without introducing product/security capability design.

## Validation

Define language-specific static/build/test gates and reference the project workflow for the final repository gate.

## Project profile

Record only the small project-specific language profile needed to apply the general rules, such as admitted language/runtime baseline and explicitly selected conventions.
